16 May 2024 · Paper · Neuroscience of Consciousness 2024(1), niae021

Exploring effects of anesthesia on complexity, differentiation, and integrated information in rat EEG

Nilsen AS, Arena A, Storm JF

In rats, integrated-information estimates from spontaneous EEG went up under anaesthesia, opposite to the stimulation-based index.

The researchers compared a stimulation-based complexity score with several scores computed from ordinary EEG in rats under three anaesthetics. Some scores worked well. But the estimates of 'integrated information', the quantity at the heart of one major theory, generally rose under propofol and sevoflurane, the reverse of what that theory expects.

Rats under propofol, sevoflurane and ketamine. PCI (electrical stimulation), LZ and geometric integrated information (PhiG) best separated wake from propofol and sevoflurane. PCI was anti-correlated with spontaneous integrated-information measures, which generally increased under propofol and sevoflurane. Authors suggest perturbation-based and spontaneous measures may be complementary.

What we do with it

A warning that Phi proxies may not track what IIT says Phi tracks. Our known-Phi network test checks this before any proxy touches brain data. Planned
